description: Background music, sound effects and ambience for AI agents and video tools: openly licensed audio with a name and a file that plays.

nodes.name: Wikimedia Commons (audio files)
nodes.license_policy: CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA only; credit kept per file
nodes.notes: MediaWiki API, filetype:audio search per theme; checked: ~1,800 hits for 'ambient' alone, each file has extmetadata licence + author. robots.txt allows the API.

nodes.name: ccMixter (CC BY music)
nodes.license_policy: CC BY and CC0 only (no NonCommercial, no NoDerivs)
nodes.notes: Public JSON query API; robots.txt disallows /Media/, /tags/ only. Files come from the api's download_url.
